title: Original owner post citations cannot authorize invented article bodies
steps: Run the article excerpt regression through the copy checker, contract exporter and write step.
expect: An invented crowd narrative with a valid owner post citation fails W04 and is never applied to the site.
A faithful short excerpt passes without demo-length padding, while maximum characters, paragraph limits and ordinary prose floors remain enforced.
A hidden, unrelated or differently cited fact cannot authorize an article body.
fence: The writer's citation and actual article body must both match the planned original owner post.
